title: Align the health workforce goal with NHWA and a system perspective
requirements:
- Add the health-system planning perspective and equitable distribution
- Distinguish workforce and facility registries from HRIS, payroll, learning and planning systems the goal also needs
- Align with NHWA distinctions (licensed, professionally active, practising) and the health labour market framework
- Separate registration from competence, privileging and scope of practice; cover non-licensed cadres
- Clarify what the workforce registry holds versus payroll and HR systems, and its privacy obligations
- Govern national role terminology alongside international classifications and align with care-services discovery patterns
- Consider sub-goals for identity and credentials, deployment and remuneration
- Address purpose-limited reuse of workforce personal data and a suggested implementation sequence
